name: @archont561/geoquery-client
//: Façade so turbo can see the TypeScript client as one node in the repo-wide task graph. `build:native` compiles the N-API addon from `crates/node-native` into this package's root, which is where `src/native.ts` looks for it; `build` is the addon and then tsc, because a `dist/` that type-checks but cannot load its own addon is not a build. `test` builds first for the same reason. Every script `cd ../..` to the repository root because cargo's target directory and the workspace manifest are resolved from there.
